Name: Additional Farm Cave PTBR
Author: Ervilhapklol
Description:
[b]Description[/b] Full Portuguese (PT-BR) translation for the [b]Farm Cave Additional Room[/b] mod in Stardew Valley. This translation localizes all configuration menus, in-game texts, and dialogue prompts while preserving the original mod structure and game tokens so Brazilian players can enjoy the extra farm cave rooms seamlessly.
[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and the original [b]Farm Cave Additional Room[/b] mod first.[/*]
[*]Download this Portuguese translation file.[/*]
[*]Extract the contents into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder and overwrite/merge with the original mod folder when prompted (making sure
[code]pt.json[/code]is placed inside the mod's
[code]i18n[/code]folder).[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and set your game language to [b]Português[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Complete Localization:[/b] Translates all mod settings (GMCM), prompts, and in-game cave room descriptions into natural Brazilian Portuguese.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI & Token Safe:[/b] Keeps all original JSON keys, formatting, and dynamic game tokens intact for error-free console loading.[/*]
[*][b]Plug-and-Play:[/b] Works directly with existing saves once the original mod is installed.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (updated base game)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/b][/*]
[*][b]Farm Cave Additional Room[/b] (original mod required — this is a translation patch only)[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] [i](optional, recommended to view translated settings in-game)[/i][/*]
[/list][b]Shout Outs[/b] Huge thanks to the original author of [b]Farm Cave Additional Room[/b] for creating such a great expansion for the farm cave, and to the Brazilian Stardew Valley modding community for the support and inspiration.
